MENU_LEVEL_DESC_BER1.en: Break through the perimeter defenses of Berlin.

MENU_LEVEL_DESC_BER2.en: Crush the German resistance as you make your way into the heart of Berlin.

MENU_LEVEL_DESC_BER3.en: Eradicate the German positions outside the Reichstag.

MENU_LEVEL_DESC_BER3B.en: Capture the Reichstag to claim ultimate victory for Mother Russia over the German war machine.

MENU_LEVEL_DESC_MAK.en: Escape capture and join Carlson's Raiders for a surprise attack on the Japanese fortifications at Makin Island.

MENU_LEVEL_DESC_OKI2.en: Assault the Japanese stronghold at Wana Ridge.

MENU_LEVEL_DESC_OKI3.en: Storm Shuri Castle to crush the last bastion of Japanese resistance at Okinawa.

MENU_LEVEL_DESC_PBY.en: Take out Japanese merchant ships with the crew of a PBY Catalina, and defend your Allied fleet against a massive kamikaze attack.

MENU_LEVEL_DESC_PEL1.en: Storm the White Beach of Peleliu Island to make way for an Allied takeover.

MENU_LEVEL_DESC_PEL1A.en: Make your way through Japanese trenches to eliminate the enemy mortar positions.

MENU_LEVEL_DESC_PEL1B.en: Take out the Japanese artillery positions defending the interior of Peleliu Island.

MENU_LEVEL_DESC_PEL2.en: Neutralize the Japanese defenses at the Peleliu airfield.

MENU_LEVEL_DESC_SEE1.en: Break through the German defenses in the town of Seelow.

MENU_LEVEL_DESC_SEE2.en: Command a T-34 Soviet tank to knock out the last German defensive line protecting Berlin.

MENU_LEVEL_DESC_SNIPER.en: Assist the injured Sgt. Reznov in assassinating the Nazi General Amsel.

MENU_LEVEL_DESC_ZOM_ASYLUM.en: Electroshock therapy. Chemically engineered beverages. Hordes of undead Nazis. Find the power to unite and send them back to their graves!

MENU_LEVEL_DESC_ZOM_PROTO.en: You drove them deep into the heart of the Reich. You thought they were dead. You were wrong.

MENU_LEVEL_NEEDS_TO_BE_COMPLETED.en: This level needs to be completed in Single Player before you can play in splitscreen.

MENU_LOCKED_MODE_DESC.en: Complete the solo campaign to unlock this game mode.

MENU_MISSION_01_01_DESC.en: Learn how to fight for the Motherland.

MENU_MISSION_01_02_DESC.en: Repel the enemy assault and demolish their hardpoint.

MENU_MISSION_02_01_DESC.en: Rush the trenches and raid the enemy supply depot.

MENU_MISSION_02_02_DESC.en: Defend a small desert village on the British line south of El Alamein.

MENU_MISSION_02_03_DESC.en: Assist your tanks in breaking through the Alamein line.

MENU_MISSION_02_04_DESC.en: Capture the town of El Daba on the Mediterranean coast.

MENU_MISSION_03_LEVEL_01_DESC.en: Repair the severed field phone line and destroy enemy tanks with sticky bombs.

MENU_MISSION_03_LEVEL_02_DESC.en: Infiltrate via the pipeline and retake the trainyard.

MENU_MISSION_04_LEVEL_01_DESC.en: Retake a series of apartment blocks in the city, and then support an attack on the enemy supply depot.

MENU_MISSION_04_LEVEL_02_DESC.en: Fight through the streets to City Hall.

MENU_MISSION_04_LEVEL_03_DESC.en: Use a sniper rifle to support the defense of City Hall.

MENU_MISSION_05_LEVEL_01_DESC.en: Engage the superior tanks of the Afrika Korps in the Libyan desert.

MENU_MISSION_05_LEVEL_02_DESC.en: Outflank and destroy 88mm anti-tank guns on a desert ridge in Libya.

MENU_MISSION_06_LEVEL_01_DESC.en: Withdraw from Toujane in a captured armored car.

MENU_MISSION_06_LEVEL_02_DESC.en: Drive the Afrika Korps out of the town of Toujane.

MENU_MISSION_06_LEVEL_03_DESC.en: Secure the Matmata route to Tunis, and shoot down enemy planes using an anti-aircraft gun.

MENU_MISSION_07_LEVEL_01_DESC.en: Locate and destroy the coastal guns and secure the enemy held bunkers.

MENU_MISSION_07_LEVEL_01_TITLE.en: The Battle of Pointe du Hoc

MENU_MISSION_07_LEVEL_03_DESC.en: Capture the village, then snipe enemy mortar teams from the top of the destroyed silo during the counterattack.

MENU_MISSION_08_LEVEL_01_DESC.en: Reconnoiter the town of Beltot and then obtain a truck to transport wounded Americans.

MENU_MISSION_08_LEVEL_02_DESC.en: Secure the crossroads at Anctoville and neutralize a German wireless station.

MENU_MISSION_08_LEVEL_03_DESC.en: Capture the town hall, church, post office, and German field HQ in the town of St. Louet.

MENU_MISSION_08_LEVEL_04_DESC.en: Capture a German field HQ, then repel the enemy counterattacks.

MENU_MISSION_09_LEVEL_01_DESC.en: Clear the town at the foot of Hill 400, room by room, house by house.

MENU_MISSION_09_LEVEL_02_DESC.en: Fight your way to the top and eliminate the German forces holding the hill.

MENU_MISSION_09_LEVEL_03_DESC.en: Repel multiple counterattacks at the top of Hill 400 until friendly forces arrive.

MENU_MISSION_10_LEVEL_01_DESC.en: Capture the German town of Wallendar and secure a crossing point on the Rhine River for the Allies.

MESSAGEBOX_IT_IS_HIGHLY_UNLIKELY.en: It is highly unlikely that a correct windowed display can be initialized with the current desktop display depth. Select 'OK' to try anyway. Press 'Cancel' if you wish to quit.

MESSAGEBOX_IT_LOOKS_LIKE_YOU_ARE.en: It looks like you are low on virtual memory. This can cause the game to run slowly and it may stop completely. It is highly recommended that you close some programs before running Call of Duty. Do you want to run Call of Duty anyway?

MESSAGEBOX_THE_RECOMMENDED_SETTINGS.en: The recommended settings have been updated since the last time you ran Call of Duty. Would you like the game to configure itself optimally with these new settings? This is recommended for most people. It will change your system settings but not your controls.

MESSAGEBOX_YOUR_COMPUTER_APPEARS.en: Your computer appears to have changed since the last time you ran Call of Duty. Would you like the game to configure itself optimally for your new hardware? This is recommended for most people. It will change your system settings but not your controls.

PLATFORM_DYK_COOP_MSG1.en: Visit Treyarch.com to go behind-the-scenes with the developers behind 'Call of Duty: World at War'.

PLATFORM_DYK_COOP_MSG10.en: Co-op hosts can invite Friends to their online lobby before the game starts.

PLATFORM_DYK_COOP_MSG11.en: Death Card cheats provide new and unique ways to customize your Co-Op matches.

PLATFORM_DYK_COOP_MSG12.en: Look for hidden scoring opportunities in Competitive Co-Op to gain an edge over other players.

PLATFORM_DYK_COOP_MSG13.en: Put a password on your Co-op or MP server to keep the general public out of your private game.

PLATFORM_DYK_COOP_MSG14.en: Battlefield Commission challenges reward you with experience points (XP) for achieving high scores in Competitive Co-Op.

PLATFORM_DYK_COOP_MSG15.en: Unlock Nazi Zombies for Co-op gameplay by completing every mission in the solo campaign.

PLATFORM_DYK_COOP_MSG16.en: Enable Competitive Scoring from the "Game Mode Settings" Menu to compete for a high-score amongst your Co-Op teammates.

PLATFORM_DYK_COOP_MSG17.en: Add bonus points to your score in Competitive co-op by enabling Death Card cheats.

PLATFORM_DYK_COOP_MSG18.en: Combine any of the 13 Death Card cheats to customize the difficulty of your online co-op matches.

PLATFORM_DYK_COOP_MSG19.en: For hardcore players, combine the cheats Body Armor, Flak Jacket, Cold Dead Hands, & Victory - you will feel the pain.

PLATFORM_DYK_COOP_MSG2.en: Earn experience points (XP) in online co-op games by completing challenges. You can view your progress in 'Rank & Challenges'.

PLATFORM_DYK_COOP_MSG20.en: In Competitive Co-Op, achieve a 9x multiplier with headshots or melees and a 10x multiplier with melees only.

PLATFORM_DYK_COOP_MSG21.en: Theater of War challenges reward you with experience points (XP) for completing co-op sessions with cheats enabled.

PLATFORM_DYK_COOP_MSG22.en: Familiarity with hidden scoring opportunities in each mission could mean the difference between 1st and 2nd place in Competitive Co-Op.

PLATFORM_DYK_COOP_MSG23.en: Visit Treyarch.com to go behind-the-scenes with the developers behind 'Call of Duty: World at War'.

PLATFORM_DYK_COOP_MSG24.en: In Competitive Co-Op, earn round bonuses by reviving the most teammates, getting the most headshots, or needing the least number of revives.

PLATFORM_DYK_COOP_MSG25.en: Visit Treyarch.com to go behind-the-scenes with the developers behind 'Call of Duty: World at War'.

PLATFORM_DYK_COOP_MSG26.en: When you host a match, combine the Body Armor and Thunder cheats - and watch the fireworks!

PLATFORM_DYK_COOP_MSG27.en: Visit Treyarch.com to go behind-the-scenes with the developers behind 'Call of Duty: World at War'.

PLATFORM_DYK_COOP_MSG28.en: In order to survive in Nazi Zombies, you have to play both offensively and defensively - board up windows to keep the zombies outside.

PLATFORM_DYK_COOP_MSG29.en: Try the Painkiller cheat in combination with Suicide King - one player can hold back as support while the other blasts through the mission.

PLATFORM_DYK_COOP_MSG3.en: Revive downed teammates in co-op before they bleed out, or all players will restart from the last checkpoint.

PLATFORM_DYK_COOP_MSG30.en: The treasure chest in Nazi Zombies is a gamble - you could get the most powerful weapon in the chest or end up with a spare pistol.

PLATFORM_DYK_COOP_MSG31.en: If you can trigger Berserker with the Sticks & Stones cheat enabled, you have mastered the art of perfect grenade placement.

PLATFORM_DYK_COOP_MSG32.en: Visit Treyarch.com to go behind-the-scenes with the developers behind 'Call of Duty: World at War'.

PLATFORM_DYK_COOP_MSG33.en: The ray gun is a powerful weapon to use against zombies.

PLATFORM_DYK_COOP_MSG4.en: Hosting a co-op game will allow you to customize the game rules.

PLATFORM_DYK_COOP_MSG5.en: Visit Treyarch.com to go behind-the-scenes with the developers behind 'Call of Duty: World at War'.
